mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_take_activity (u_id, take_id, activity_id, activity_name, take_date, take_count, strategy_id, state, uuid, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{uId}, #{takeId}, #{activityId}, #{activityName}, #{takeDate}, (SELECT total_count - left_count FROM user_take_activity_count WHERE u_id = #{uId} AND activity_id = #{activityId}), #{strategyId}, #{state}, #{uuid}, now(), now())
mapper.update: UPDATE user_take_activity SET state = 1 WHERE u_id = #{uId} AND activity_id = #{activityId} AND take_id = #{takeId} AND state = 0
mapper.select: SELECT activity_id, take_id, strategy_id, state FROM user_take_activity WHERE u_id = #{uId} AND activity_id = #{activityId} AND state = 0 ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
